pictures.author: Luna Moonshine
pictures.observations: Recent close view establishes cream/white plaster and pale stone bands/corbels rather than older red trim; taller projecting central stair turret with upper lancet head/crenellations, main crenellated gallery, sparse slit windows, dark lower housing and low natural island bank. Visitors/stacked pebbles are not model details.

pictures.author: Garumisalami
pictures.observations: Modern river-side view corroborates pale standing tower and high projecting turret on the small island. The river, bank and separate Ehrenfels ruin remain native context, not part of the tower asset.

pictures.author: Arcalino
pictures.observations: Older clearer close exterior resolves central projection, tiered corbel/gallery rhythm and small lower housing. Its strong red trim is historical-looking evidence and is deliberately not copied into the current pale finish. Fine hidden reverse openings and interior inventory remain approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific current Mouse Tower at Bingen: mapped asymmetric main body/projecting eastern stair turret, pale plaster/stone corner pilasters and bands, small genuinely recessed closed windows, projecting corbel gallery/flat deck and open crenellated parapet, taller octagonal shaft/lancet head/closed cap and crenellated crown, sparse iron rods, bounded dark lower housing/hip cap. Four existing shared stucco/raw sandstone/slate/paint graphs. No older red finish, copied heraldry/inscriptions/photo atlas, furnished interior, neighboring castle, whole island mesh or river-covering platform.
